title: Ribo the Frog
moral: Everyone has their own unique talent.

scenes.summary: Ribo loves music but cannot sing like the other frogs.
scenes.text:
Ribo the Frog Who Couldn’t Sing

In a green pond surrounded by tall reeds and blooming lilies, lived a little frog named Ribo.

Ribo loved music.

Every evening, the frogs gathered by the pond and sang together.

“Croak-croak! Crooooak!”

Their voices echoed beautifully across the water.

But Ribo had a problem…

He couldn’t sing.
scenes.image_prompt: cute frog sitting by pond with other frogs singing, colorful lilies and reeds, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Ribo tries to sing but feels embarrassed when others laugh.
scenes.text:
When Ribo tried to sing, it came out like—

“Cr… cro… croak… squeeeak!”

The other frogs stopped and stared.

“That sounded funny,” giggled one frog.

Ribo felt embarrassed.

“I’ll just listen,” he said quietly.
scenes.image_prompt: frog looking embarrassed while other frogs giggle, pond setting, soft cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: Ribo feels left out until Tomo the Turtle encourages him to find his talent.
scenes.text:
Every night, Ribo sat by the pond, listening to the others sing.

He tapped his feet to the rhythm.

“I wish I could sing like them,” he sighed.

But no matter how hard he tried…

“Cr… squeak!”

It never sounded right.

One day, Tomo the Turtle slowly walked by.

“Why so quiet, Ribo?” he asked.

“I can’t sing,” Ribo said sadly.

Tomo smiled.

“Not everyone has the same talent,” he said. “But everyone has some talent.”

Ribo tilted his head.

“Like what?”

“Let’s find out,” said Tomo.
scenes.image_prompt: wise turtle talking to sad frog by pond, calm evening scene, friendly cartoon style

scenes.summary: Ribo discovers he can create rhythm and adds music to the frogs’ singing.
scenes.text:
That evening, as the frogs began to sing, Ribo sat nearby.

Tap… tap… tap…

He tapped a rock with a stick.

Tap-tap! Tap-tap!

It made a nice rhythm.

The frogs paused.

“Hey… that sounds good!” one said.

Ribo tried again.

Tap-tap! Tap-tap! Tap!

Soon, the frogs started singing along with his beat.

“Croak-croak! Crooooak!”
scenes.image_prompt: frog happily tapping rhythm on rock while other frogs sing along, lively pond scene, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Ribo becomes the group’s drummer and feels proud of his talent.
scenes.text:
Ribo’s eyes sparkled.

“I’m making music!” he said happily.

“You’re our drummer!” the frogs cheered.

From that day on, Ribo didn’t feel left out.

He didn’t sing…

But he made the music even better.

Everyone is good at something.

If you can’t do one thing, you might shine at another.

The End
